title: Holotropic Breathwork Workshop
description: Go deep — like, really deep. This 6-hour breathwork workshop uses rhythmic breathing and music to guide you into altered states of consciousness for emotional release and self-discovery. Led by Punam Rai, Singapore's only GTT-certified Holotropic Breathwork facilitator. Includes two breathing rounds, mandala drawing, and a group integration circle. Not your average chill session.
